native_role_policy_baseline: Inherited historical V3 roles from population_20261023 exact order design; not DSTRUCT or RFUSE

join_fields.member_object_ids: Pipe-separated frozen v2 original-answer identifiers in worker order
join_fields.pool_input_sha256: Canonical full pool input digest; matching references and members alone are not used to override this digest
join_fields.base_path_id: The exact paired natural base path; equal to path_id for a natural order
join_fields.natural_base_path_id: Explicit alias of base_path_id in materialized new prefix values
join_fields.new_index: Natural uniform order index, 0..207; stage1 0..103, stage2 104..207; new policies use 0..15
join_fields.seed: Unsigned 64-bit integer represented as a decimal string; do not round through IEEE double precision
join_fields.replicate: 96+new_index for new orders, avoiding old focus indices; identify cohorts by path_id/batch, not replicate alone

units.B8L2: Frozen main quality score, points on its existing 0-100 scale, nullable
units.geometry.points: Alternating top/bottom panorama coordinates in the frozen 1024x512 coordinate system
units.geometry.footprint: XZ coordinates normalized by camera height, same within-image frame
units.source_time_total_seconds: Inherited source-clock total only when all members have that field
units.target_time_total_seconds: Inherited target-clock total only when all members have that field
units.native_evaluation_wall_seconds: Computer execution time; never annotator labor or parallel delivery time

geometry_fields.geometry_state_pointer: Relative compact final-candidate file and 1-based JSONL line; not a promise of full identity state
geometry_fields.full_state_pointer: Optional pointer to a retained complete native identity state; blank means not retained, not failed fusion
geometry_fields.geometry_available: Native candidate object exists; this alone does not establish valid polygon geometry
geometry_fields.complete_floor_evaluable: Use with a non-null footprint for the inherited floor-geometry analysis support
geometry_fields.complete_evaluable: Inherited complete geometry qualification, kept separate from score_available

status_fields.endpoint_state: Added explicit execution/score category; see README_ENGINE_ZH.md
status_fields.reference_unavailable: Reference support does not permit the score
status_fields.policy_deferred: Frozen two-person scoring deferral; this term is unrelated to which entrant-priority policy was used
status_fields.unscored_nonpolicy: Non-two-person executed endpoint with missing B8L2; broader than actual_consensus_failure

missingness: Missing Q is never filled with zero. Requested but unexecuted teams have no result row and remain in the exact request table. Empty new-request pools can have fully materialized new random paths using cached exact endpoints.
weighting: All random prefix occurrences are retained. Reusing an exact endpoint does not deduplicate its random sampling weight. Full-pool prefixes all refer to one finite team and add no new team variation.
source_table_resolution: Exact request source_table names the unified logical new scalar dataset. Complete pool/part scalar shards are its authority; assemble_scalar_table.py can materialize NEW_ENDPOINT_SCALARS.csv.gz. dependencies_by_pool records actual per-stage output locations.
